Interaction: drag to orbit (yaw + clamped pitch with inertia), flick or tap to shake (also Shake button and spacebar), wheel to zoom, auto-spin toggle and reset view. Glass shell is rendered with edge refraction darkening, sheen, specular highlights and rim; wooden pedestal with engraved plate and cast shadow. Verified logic by review (in-place transform safety, geometry inside globe radius, sorting/occlusion order, resize/DPR handling) and packaging via check: no external assets, no network, classic script, no storage.
